question: What is the average of Net profit from 2018 to 2023?

steps.description: Locate the row labeled 'Net profit/total operating income(%)' in the table
Read the Net profit value for the year 2018 from the identified row
Read the Net profit value for the year 2019 from the identified row
Read the Net profit value for the year 2020 from the identified row
Read the Net profit value for the year 2021 from the identified row
Read the Net profit value for the year 2022 from the identified row
Read the Net profit value for the year 2023 from the identified row
Sum all Net profit values from steps 2 through 7
Divide the sum from step_8 by 6 to calculate the average
